evidence_scheme: Each claim not proved on the page carries one class: empirical result (paper and page), engineering check (this chapter's code or shown arithmetic), product claim, speaker judgment (with recording time). Definitions and results proved on the page carry no label. Each section opens with a provenance line: lecture / research extension / original construction.
running_case: p_data = 0.5 N(mu, I) + 0.5 N(-mu, I) on R^{n_x}, every coordinate of mu equal to 2/sqrt(n_x), ||mu||_2 = 2; label y = 1 for the +mu cluster. Bayes logit 2 mu^T x. Used for the attack (Propositions 1-3), adversarial training, the backdoor argument, the GAN divergence of a one-cluster generator, and the DDPM forward marginal, optimal noise predictor and sampler. Original construction. The slide 13 neuron and the face-verification thread (backdoors, exercise 6) are reused as sub-examples.
